svg.title: Silhouette halls backdrop, night 4: bunk to officers' wing
svg.desc: Silhouette halls backdrop for night 4, bunk to officers' wing: the tall hall side-on as a lit cream sheet, windows at 3.5 m throwing light long and down, the pipe run at 2.7 m, claw marks higher than a man; the file room door held open with sodium light spilled across the floor, a ladder to the pipes, and the dark corner of the officers' wing the shadow reaches first.
